exec: // Confirm a member can leave the group.
pm.test('member can leave the group', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Use the member token to leave the saved group. Expect HTTP 200; the next request checks that this token no longer grants access to the group's quizzes.

item.name: Former member cannot list group quizzes

exec: // The same member token must no longer grant access after leaving.

request.description: Reuse the former member's token to request the saved group's quizzes after leaving. Expect HTTP 403 rather than access to the list.

exec: // Gateway and handler implementations can return 403 or 401 for a rejected token.
pm.test('invalid bearer token is rejected', () => pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Call a protected route with a malformed bearer token. Expect 401 or 403 and never a successful response.

exec: // Clear the inherited token; this request also explicitly opts out of authentication.
// The protected endpoint must reject requests without a bearer token.

request.description: Clear the collection's current accessToken and explicitly disable authentication for this request. Expect HTTP 401 when requesting the protected group list without a bearer token.
